messages:
maya: Quick sync 1 need final hero lines + 2 CTAs for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Launch next Tue.
jonas: I'll draft Hosted. Goal: dev velocity + predictable latency.
sara: Layout: hero, one-line subhead, three micro-benefits. Keep visuals neutral.
kevin: Product constraints: Dedicated must call out SLA, reserved GPU pools, and burst capacity. Private needs VPC, KMS, and on-prem/air-gapped.
maya: Posting compact options 1 pick one per page and approve CTAs.
maya: HOSTED (pick one):
1) "Deploy LLM features in hours, not months." 1 sub: "Low-latency hosted API with streaming and usage controls."
2) "A developer-first API for production inference." 1 sub: "Start with examples, scale with predictable perf."
jonas: Lean 2 for docs continuity. 1 is good for marketing hero.
kevin: Hosted CTAs: primary "Start free", secondary "View benchmarks". Add docs link.
sara: Micro-benefits for Hosted: "Low latency","Streaming & function calls","Cost breakdowns". Approved.
maya: DEDICATED (pick one):
A) "Reserved capacity for business-critical models." 1 sub: "Single-tenant GPU pools, SLA, and enterprise controls."
B) "Throughput you can predict, latency you can guarantee." 1 sub: "Autoscale, burst, and policy routing."
jonas: Use A on the marketing page, B in the technical spec section.
kevin: Dedicated CTAs: "Contact sales" and "Estimate capacity". Include small badge row: "SLA / Reserved capacity / Enterprise support".
sara: Micro-benefits for Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools","SLA","Autoscale + burst". Add partner logos under hero.
maya: PRIVATE (pick one):
i) "Run Redwood in your VPC or on-prem." 1 sub: "Customer-managed keys, audit logs, and air-gapped option."
ii) "Private deployments for compliance and control." 1 sub: "Full control over data, networking, and secrets."
kevin: Use i) publicly, ii) in sales decks. Add: "Same API surface as Hosted for easy migration."
jonas: Add a one-line note on model compatibility/quantization recommendations for infra engineers.
sara: Micro-benefits for Private: "VPC & KMS","Air-gapped option","Enterprise support".
maya: Final asks: 1) confirm hero picks in this thread, 2) thumbs up on CTAs and micro-benefits so I can push to CMS.
ops-bot: Reminder: marketing deploy scheduled 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC.
jonas: Approved 44d (pick Hosted 2, Dedicated A, Private i).
sara: Approved 44d
kevin: Approved 44d
maya: Thanks all 1 I'll upload copy and share preview links.
